newsitem.title: USA: Bank United says holders tender notes.
newsitem.headline: Bank United says holders tender notes.

text.p: Bank United Corp said on Tuesday that holders of a majority of its $115 million of outstanding 8.05 percent senior notes due May 15, 1998 had been tendered, along with consents to amend the terms of the notes.
The proposed amendments would, among other things, eliminate substantially all of the indenture's restrictive covenants, Bank United said.

Under the terms of the company's tender offer and consent solicitation, only noteholders who tender their notes and deliver the consents through March 26 will be entitled to a $5.00 per $1,000 principal amount consent payment, Bank United said.
Holders who tender senior notes after March 26 but prior to April 10 will not be entitled to a consent payment, Bank United said.
